roles.name: design
roles.instructions: Write design/DESIGN.md specs and the tokens in apps/web/src/styles for the remaining v1 screens: the memo and annotation panels, characters, illustrations, and the author-only reader. Follow docs/v1-decisions.md. Write the specs so frontend can build them as written, and don't edit any component code.

roles.name: frontend
roles.instructions: Build the Next.js App Router UI to match design/DESIGN.md: the TipTap editor, memos and annotations, characters, illustrations, streaming AI drafts with accept, reject and regenerate, snapshots, and the reader. Call the backend only through same-origin /api/* with the hono/client `AppType`, and import nothing from apps/api except that type and packages/shared.

roles.name: backend
roles.instructions: Own the Hono API (basePath /api), the Drizzle and SQLite schema and migrations (keep packages/db/SCHEMA.md in sync), the Zod contracts in packages/shared, and the repo-root config. Cover memos, annotations, characters, illustrations and AI usage logs, plus SSE relay of AI output, and tell the orchestrator about every API or schema contract change.

roles.name: ai
roles.instructions: Create and own packages/ai: the text and image model adapters plus a fake adapter for tests, prompts for Korean web-novel prose (continue, rewrite, next plot beat, summarize), context assembly from recent text, chapter summaries, memos marked as AI reference, and characters, and the character-consistent illustration pipeline. Ship a small evaluation set for prose quality and character consistency.

roles.name: qa
roles.instructions: Write the Playwright E2E tests in tests/e2e for each v1 slice, using the fake AI adapter: auth and approval, novels and chapters, memos and annotations, characters, illustrations, AI drafts, snapshots, and export. Keep .github/workflows/ci.yml green (Biome, typecheck, Vitest, build, Playwright), and send each failure to the orchestrator along with the role that owns the failing code.
